name: Tempester n°30: a SysEx message that never ends is abandoned after about 3 s
explanation: A sender that stops in the middle of a SysEx (no F7) left the shared SysEx state (command [address], byte counter [address], substate [address]; for a DIN header the DIN running status [address] = F0) waiting with no time limit: the "**** Receiving ... ****" screen stayed and swallowed the panel and the incoming MIDI notes, a 61/62 file stayed open, until the next SysEx start (USB) or DIN status byte (cable DIN). Tick: the main loop's 24 ms event (Timer 3, PR3 = 20000 at 1:1 on the 40 MHz peripheral clock = 500.025 us, decrements [address] every second interrupt; at 0 the main loop reloads it to 24 and calls [routine]): that call at [address] now goes through TICK (0x9d07d200), which tail-calls [routine]. One event every 23.0 to 24.0 ms plus at most one main-loop pass. Idle counter [address] (u16 of .bss written only by [routine], never read): zero after every SysEx reset ([routine]) and, through the delay slot of the store in [routine] ([address], the only store of a received SysEx byte, DIN and USB), after every received SysEx byte. Busy: counter != 0 or substate != 0, or cable = DIN and DIN running status = F0; OS updates 71-74 exempt (the main loop never runs once they are dispatched). After 130 events without a byte (>= 2.967 s, nominal 3.12 s) the message is abandoned like n°18/n°19: DIN running status reset only if the SysEx cable is the DIN, [routine] (file closed, state 0), then [routine](6, 0, 0, 0x25) if a reception was in progress (command != 0 and (counter != 0 or substate != 0)), which returns the Receiving screen to the boot screen. Main-loop context only; flasher page untouched. Code: 0x9d07d200-0x9d07d2bf (48 words), 2 words in place.

edits.why: jal 0x9d07d200 ; main loop, 24 ms event: was "jal [address]" (49 software timers), now called by TICK (tail call); delay slot "sb t2,-0x7f13(gp)" ([address] = 24) kept; ra = [address]
sh zero,-0x7f90(gp) ; [routine] (the only store of a received SysEx byte, DIN [address] and USB [address]): delay slot of "jal [address]", was nop; idle counter [address] = 0
bne t1,zero,0x9d07d2b8 ; 71-74: an OS update is never abandoned
lhu t2,-0x7f8c(gp) ; delay slot: byte counter [address]
bne t4,zero,0x9d07d240 ; waiting for data bytes or for the F7
lbu t7,-0x7ea8(gp) ; delay slot: DIN running status [address]
bne t7,t6,0x9d07d2b8 ; not in a DIN SysEx header
lhu t5,-0x7f90(gp) ; idle counter: events since the last stored byte or reset
and s0,s0,t0 ; s0 = a reception was in progress (n°19): command != 0 and (counter != 0 or substate != 0)
bne t5,t6,0x9d07d288 ; cable USB (or none): the DIN stream is not the stuck one, its running status is kept (n°18)
jal [address] ; [routine]: running status 0, DIN data pointer (as [routine] with cable DIN)
jal [address] ; [routine]: file closed, command, substate, stream mode, ring and counter 0, idle counter 0
or a1,zero,zero ; command 0, as the error ends and n°19
jal [address] ; [routine](6, 0, 0, 0x25): the Receiving screen goes back to the boot screen (n°19 part 2)
j [address] ; the replaced call (software timers), returns to [address]
